title: jacobinia pohliana
intro: Jacobinia pohliana, commonly known as Brazilian plume flower, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing pain and combating infections. The therapeutic actions of Jacobinia pohliana include acting as an anti-inflammatory agent, reducing fever, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
